text:
I checked available knowledge sources and found no documented, ACME-specific threshold definition for "positive coverage" beyond the API's own field description: `sentiment_score` is "0 (negative) to 100 (positive)" on a 0–100 scale, meaning 50 is the neutral midpoint and any score above 50 is on the positive side.

Using the 'Brand mentions' monitor (id 501) daily trend data for 1–28 June 2026, the days with `sentiment_score` strictly above 50 (positive) are:
- Jun 2 (76), Jun 3 (76), Jun 5 (52), Jun 6 (60), Jun 7 (74), Jun 8 (80), Jun 9 (75), Jun 13 (76), Jun 15 (77), Jun 16 (83), Jun 19 (60), Jun 21 (70), Jun 23 (84), Jun 24 (65), Jun 26 (77)

That is 15 days out of the 28-day window (Jun 11 and Jun 27 sat exactly at the neutral midpoint of 50 and were not counted as positive; days at or below 50 such as Jun 1, 4, 10, 12, 14, 17, 18, 20, 22, 25, 28 were negative/neutral).

FINAL ANSWER: 15
